content.value: A septic tank having dimension 1m x 3m.x 1.5m is designed to serve a household (15) of six persons, who produce $7 5 \mathsf { L P C D }$ of waste water. Design a soakage pit for the disposal of effluent from septic tank. Consider the soil is porous silty clay loam.
